# Life180 Labs

> Life180 Labs designs, builds, and operates AI systems - from workflow
> automation for growing businesses to production AI infrastructure for
> AI startups. 15+ years of enterprise product experience, Fortune 100
> background, AI-first delivery, built in India and serving clients
> globally.

Life180 Labs works with two audiences: established business owners who
want AI systems that create measurable business value without adding
operational overhead, and AI startups that need production-grade
infrastructure delivered at startup speed. Every engagement ends with an
implementation plan or a working system - not just a slide deck.

## Homepage

- [Homepage](https://www.life180labs.com/): We build AI systems that
  businesses actually use. Overview of the differentiators, featured
  work (Intelligent Systems), and site structure.

## Services

- [AI Strategy](https://www.life180labs.com/services/ai-strategy): AI strategy
  that turns ambition into measurable impact - AI roadmap, use case discovery,
  AI transformation, and implementation planning.
- [AI Development](https://www.life180labs.com/services/ai-development): AI
  agents, custom AI applications, workflow automation, and enterprise
  integrations built production-ready.
- [AI Operations](https://www.life180labs.com/services/ai-ops): LLM evaluations,
  prompt testing, benchmarking, human feedback, and monitoring and optimization
  for AI systems running in production.
- [AI Training](https://www.life180labs.com/services/ai-training): Corporate AI
  workshops, leadership training, AI adoption programs, and team enablement.
